text:
Hannah: Tiny idea 9: Pocket Arcade Swap + LAN tomorrow evening? Bring any handhelds/portable consoles (Steam Deck, Switch Lite, GBA) and we can do a rotating couch-couch setup. low-key, no pressure. :handshake: :game_die:

Omar: love that. i can bring my Steam Deck and a usb-c hub for Ethernet. also have a spare copy of TowerFall Ascension keys if anyone wants it.

Pri: i'm in if there's space. can bring a Switch Lite and my awkward but reliable Bluetooth controller. snacks? i'll do savory muffins. :muffin:

Leo: count me in for handheld show-and-tell. i have a modded PSP and a weird USB arcade stick. can we do a quick "best tiny indie" rotation?

Hannah: thinking start ~6:30pm, lounge B reserved? ops-bot, can we grab Lounge B 6:15-9:30pm for this? TV+HDMI for mirroring deck screens.

ops-bot: Reservation request received for Lounge B 6:15pm-9:30pm. Please confirm AV preference: "TV+HDMI" or "Projector". Also note: please label any shared chargers.

Hannah: TV+HDMI pls. Also small poll on games to rotate (reply with the short code):
```
- TF = TowerFall Ascension
- MT = Move or Die
- SP = Spelunky 2
- LM = Local multiplayer indies (open floor)
```

Omar: TF

Pri: LM

Leo: TF

Hannah: looks like TowerFall is winning. We'll do a short indie demo block first followed by TowerFall queues. Remote folks welcome via Steam Remote Play; we'll post link.

Pri: i'll bring a labeled tub for chargers and a little sign "DO NOT STEAL (pls)". also savory muffins confirmed.

Leo: tiny PSA: if you bring a PSP, bring the data cable. my spare battery is flaky.

meme-bot: GIF posted: "tiny arcade, big drama" :joystick:

Omar: also bringing ethernet switch for stable low-latency matches. If anyone needs power or extra joy-cons, ping me.

ops-bot: Reservation confirmed for Lounge B with TV+HDMI. Reminder: return AV cables to storage and clean up after event.

Hannah: sweet. Quick RSVP: whos definitely coming in person? Reply with Y/N. (remote folks welcome)

Omar: Y

Pri: Y

Leo: Y

Hannah: Great. I'll post the Steam Remote Play link tomorrow and a tiny schedule (6:15 setup, 6:30 indie rotation, 7:15 TowerFall rounds). Low-stress, tiny prizes (leftover stickers). See y'all! :partyparrot:
